features.title: Reach a sandbox through one channel on its own stdin and stdout
features.summary: A small guest agent runs as a sandbox's first process and answers file operations and process starts over the sandbox's stdin and stdout, so the user's DSH reaches a container with no published port, no mounted socket and no docker exec per call.
failureModes: A guest agent that speaks another protocol version is refused with the instruction to rebuild the sandbox image.
When the channel closes, every pending request fails with GUEST_CLOSED and every running process reports an exit, instead of hanging.
With --confine, a path outside the workspace, through a symlink or a missing parent included, is refused with FS_SANDBOX_DENIED.
Closing the channel stops every process group in the sandbox and exits the agent, which ends a container started with --rm.

verification.testName: writes, reads, stats and lists, with a version that changes on every write
refuses a stale version, an existing file on create, and a missing file on replace
refuses paths outside its root when confined, including through a symlink and a missing parent
runs a process in the given folder with its output, input and exit code
fails pending requests and ends the agent when the channel closes
serves the same operations with no network, as a non-root user, at the host path of the workspace

telemetry.reason: A library: the plugin that opens a sandbox owns the span for that unit of work and names this channel in its own catalog.

ioDelegation.reason: Starts the guest agent process for the provider that asked; the provider's sandbox start span covers it.
Requests on an already open sandbox channel; each runs under the caller's span (a tool call or the sandbox lifecycle step).
